cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get us there without the car. It won't start, which gives us a lovely chance to walk together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's raining. I don't want a lovely soaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you choose the covered route. Excellent: a walk with scenery and shelter. I'll follow your umbrella.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My shoe's leaking. I can only manage the shortest way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better, you know the efficient route. Set the pace and I'll carry your bag. We get time together and an expert shortcut; the car never offered us that.
